title: Team Ham Expanded Trivia Pack
description: A diverse 12-category sample pack with 60 standard clues and one Final Jeoparty clue per category. Expanded content only; this does not change the proposed first-release board size or implement final-round gameplay.

metadata.notes: Pack and clue metadata may include author (string), notes (string), tags (array of strings), and media (array of attachment objects with url, mimeType, and optional alt text). Clue type defaults to text; reserved types are text, daily_double, and media. Consumers should ignore unknown optional metadata fields, but explicitly reject unsupported schema versions or clue types rather than silently changing gameplay. These extension conventions describe the sample format; they do not implement parser, media, or Daily Double support.

scoring.notes: A standard clue's tier is its intrinsic difficulty. Look up its points in the selected round's pointsByTier table; do not derive points from clue IDs or array positions. Existing IDs are stable opaque identifiers even where they contain legacy point values. Final clues use tier final and are not scored by these standard-round tables.
